purpose: prequalify whether currently trading Binance Leveraged Tokens leave a distinct market-direction-hedgeable primary-market NAV versus spot parity mechanism worth an explicitly authorized GET-only tokenInfo study

source_contracts.use: current official OpenAPI schema classifies BLVT tokenInfo as API-key MARKET_DATA and exposes NAV current baskets real leverage funding rate current purchase and redemption fee percentages and daily limits
current official public market-data contract permits unauthenticated exchangeInfo reads through data-api.binance.vision

mechanism.subscribe_then_sell_spot_identity: subscribe at current NAV plus exact purchase fee then sell the same BLVT token on spot while hedging the current basket exposure
mechanism.buy_spot_then_redeem_identity: buy the same BLVT token on spot then redeem at current NAV minus exact redemption fee while hedging the current basket exposure
mechanism.gross_subscribe_gate: spot executable bid minus NAV purchase charge must be positive before spot fee hedge entry and exit funding slippage delay and stress
mechanism.gross_redeem_gate: NAV redemption proceed minus spot executable ask must be positive before spot fee hedge entry and exit funding slippage delay and stress
mechanism.why_not_yet_direction_independent: real leverage and current basket can rebalance; subscription redemption and hedge are non-atomic and account-specific, so exact basket quantity delay and hedge completion must be bound before any neutral claim

capture.purpose: retain the complete public exchange inventory and admit only current symbols carrying the official LEVERAGED permission

stopping_rules.zero_current_trading_leveraged_symbols: terminalize the public inventory until a new official BLVT listing
stopping_rules.positive_current_inventory: record a candidate only; tokenInfo requires an ephemeral API key and explicit GET-only authority, and no spot or futures book may be requested until the exact NAV and fee prefilter is positive
stopping_rules.positive_NAV_prefilter: freeze a separate synchronized all-cost study before any books and require exact basket hedge quantity primary-market processing delay spot and hedge fees funding slippage orphan capacity and stress
stopping_rules.mutation_boundary: subscription redemption spot order futures order transfer and account change each require separate explicit authority
